summary: Verified font-weight fix for .step b in El Método section. All assertions pass: computed font-weight=600, outlined style (color transparent, -webkit-text-stroke 1.2px brand red rgb(216,26,14)=var(--acid)), all 4 numbers 01-04 render with correct h3/p titles. No regressions: /, /aviso-de-privacidad, /aviso-legal all HTTP 200; 11 project cards; Land Rover/MTV/BBVA/Tec/Pachuca/Tajín/HLB brands present; Zoebisch absent from text and images; mobile-menu-toggle exists and is clickable at 375px viewport; no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: brand red --acid resolves to rgb(216,26,14), not rgb(188,0,0) as mentioned in the review request. Not a bug — just a doc/spec mismatch. Verify the intended brand red value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cosmetic-only fix verified. .step b now uses font-weight:600 (previously 800). Outline numerals render cleanly. Mobile menu toggle present via data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle'. IntersectionObserver reveal (.rv -> .in) works when #method is scrolled into view; force adding class 'in' also works if needed.
